headline: Senegal Debt Reaches 128.6% of GDP as IMF Discussions Continue
summary: Senegal's sovereign debt reached 128.6% of GDP as the country negotiates a $2.2 billion IMF package following a Moody's credit downgrade to Caa2.
why: IMF financing packages provide critical liquidity for emerging nations facing severe fiscal deficits and rising debt service burdens.

impacts.name: Senegal
impacts.why: A heavy debt load and a Caa2 rating raise sovereign borrowing costs and elevate refinancing risks.
